text:
maddie_marketing: Heads up — compact PLG test idea for the launch posts + workshop. Goal: increase first-successful-prompt and workshop RSVPs.

maddie_marketing: Quick plan: reserve 2.5k credits, drop a 4-template "starter pack" at signup, 2 lightweight nudges (day1 toast + day3 email), and run 3-arm split: control / credits-only / credits+pack+nudge.

leo_growth: routing: tag signups utm_campaign=launchkit and cohort=launchkit-pilot. auto-enroll first 2.5k or 21 days. Manual outreach to top 150.

anya_product: primary KPI = % with prompt.execute(template_id) within 7d. target +6pp. secondary = RSVP to workshop and 14d paid conversion.

nina_analytics: will add experiment_id to events and build dashboard. recommend allocation 25/37.5/37.5 for power if sample limited.

sam_design: UI: first-login mini-modal with 3 featured templates + "Try" CTA and opt-in checkbox for anonymized usage. I'll drop copy + mock by EOD.

eng_ops_bot: experiment recorded: exp.launchkit.5112345678 | cohorts: control/credits/full | allocation set | experiment_id=exp.launchkit.5112345678

maddie_marketing: Action items: maddie confirm credits + doc, sam mock+copy, anya follow-up rules, nina dashboard + power calc, leo outreach list. Greenlight tomorrow unless objections. :seedling:
